fact: Government Gazette notice of 1 November 2019 invites comment on draft SANS 27003 and SANS 27004 (ISO/IEC information security management guidance), and states ISO/IEC 27001 is published in South Africa as an identical adoption under the designation SANS 27001.
title: Standards Act: Standards matters: Schedules: Comments invited (Notice 593 of 2019)
publisher: Government Gazette, Republic of South Africa
